name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Famous Sweet Cream Cheese Roll (Porto's #1 Icon)
whyItWorks: Porto's legendary #1 signature item! Paper-thin, crispy caramelized puff pastry stuffed with sweet cream cheese. 100% seed-free, nut-free, and melt-in-your-mouth tender.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 2-3 warm Cheese Rolls fresh from the bakery case; enjoy before walking over to Knott's Berry Farm.
